guitar.notes: French garage-rock band frontman/guitarist; general Fender-style gear, not a famous specific model.

tone.target: bright indie pop-rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright indie pop-rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A bright, polished indie rock chain using a low-gain British amp model (AC30) combined with Chorus for shimmer and Digital Delay for tails.

rig.name: BB Brunes - Nico Teen Love - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide light, transparent crunch and attack boost.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen for its clean, mid-focused breakup, mimicking a small tube overdrive without excessive grit.

alternatives.model: Blues OD (if more warmth is needed)

blocks.purpose: Add the required 'chorus shimmer' and width to the tone.

blocks.gap: The light crunch is handled by the Green OD and amp choice; no dedicated distortion unit is required.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic bright, clean headroom and British voicing (Vox AC30 clue).

alternatives.model: US Deluxe (if a more American chime is desired)

blocks.purpose: Complement the British voicing and maintain a bright, polished sound.

alternatives.model: UK Basket 4x12 (if more open air tone is desired)

blocks.purpose: Brighten the overall tone and enhance clarity for pop-rock sheen.
Add the required 'delay tails' and spaciousness without sounding muddy.
Provide subtle ambience and polish without the 'big reverb' sound.

alternatives.model: Plate (if a more controlled, metallic shimmer is preferred)

improvements.summary: Enhance cabinet realism to better capture the desired polished indie pop-rock sheen.

proposals.reason: The current UK Vintage 4x12 might be too dark; a brighter, more open cabinet will enhance the 'pop-rock sheen' and clarity.
